considered_not_added: Abrocitinib population PK/PD platelet model (Wang 2022 BJCP, doi 10.1111/bcp.15334; FDA review section 16.5.2.2.3; Mukherjee 2020 K-PD, doi 10.1002/psp4.12548): an in-silico model, but fitted to pooled patient data that include the psoriasis Phase 2 B7451005, so in psoriasis it describes the data it was built on (visual predictive check) rather than predicting them; its forward simulations chose the atopic-dermatitis 100/200 mg QD dose, not a psoriasis dose. As on the FLT3 tile, a patient-data-fitted exposure-response model is not a preclinical model system; the psoriasis platelet fall it describes is already scored contra on the whole-blood-pSTAT and rat/monkey-tox safety tracks.
Abrocitinib EASI/IGA efficacy PK/PD models, QT PK/PD model (Clin Pharmacol Drug Dev 2022) and PBPK/DDI work: atopic dermatitis or healthy-volunteer only; no psoriasis endpoint was modelled.

Itacitinib rodent arthritis (Covington 2020, doi 10.1016/j.ejphar.2020.173505): the same cross-indication system as the draft's jak1-rat-aia track, so not a new track; Covington's three mouse IBD models and acute GvHD model predict nothing about psoriasis and were compared with no psoriasis patients.
Itacitinib in xenogeneic GvHD in humanized NSG mice (Bone Marrow Transplant 2021, doi 10.1038/s41409-021-01363-1): GvHD indication; no psoriasis comparison.

Abrocitinib in DNCB-induced atopic-dermatitis mice (Sci Rep 2024, doi 10.1038/s41598-024-73951-2, as comparator for PLAG) and in house-dust-mite AD mice for mechanical alloknesis (Biomedicines 2025; J Dermatol Sci 2024): AD models run after the psoriasis Phase 2 with no psoriasis endpoint; an AD model cannot be paired with a psoriasis trial.

Imiquimod psoriasis-like mouse (JID 2022 IL-6R/STAT3 keratinocyte paper, doi 10.1016/j.jid.2021.09.012; SAR-20347 JAK1/TYK2; topical baricitinib formulations 2024): the JAK inhibitors dosed are tofacitinib, baricitinib and SAR-20347, none a member; members are named only as context in the full text.

Ex-vivo or 3D human psoriatic skin and patient-derived cells: no study dosing a member was found; the primary-human-lymphocyte and whole-blood STAT-phosphorylation assays (Covington 2020, Vazquez 2018) are the draft's jak1-human-whole-blood-pstat system.

Solcitinib: no public preclinical pharmacology; the lesional-skin gene-expression change in Ludbrook 2016 (doi 10.1111/bjd.14399) is a patient PD readout with no model to pair it to; the 2026 murine immune aplastic anaemia study (Hemasphere, doi 10.1002/hem3.70330) is not psoriasis.
Human genetic model (JAK1 gain-of-function atopic/eosinophilic syndromes; JAK-inhibitor pharmacogenetics review 2026): no psoriasis genotype-response comparison with a member drug exists.

Spatial proteomics-guided JAK inhibition in toxic epidermal necrolysis (Nature 2024, doi 10.1038/s41586-024-08061-0): patient-sample-guided treatment in another disease; not psoriasis and not a member-specific prediction.

Network meta-analyses of JAK inhibitors in plaque psoriasis (JEADV 2022, doi 10.1111/jdv.18263; BMC Rheumatol 2022; Heliyon 2025): tier-4 patient-side sources with no model side; they change no status on the existing tracks, where all three Phase 2s are already scored.
Abrocitinib off-label psoriasis, palmoplantar pustulosis and dupilumab-induced psoriasis case reports and the JAAD Int 2026 off-label systematic review: patient-side anecdotes with no model.
